intro: Tourism, sugar, bananas and citrus drive Belize's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Reef and Maya tourism is the biggest industry. Sugar, bananas, citrus and shrimp are exported.

chapters.title: Protecting the reef
text: Belize banned offshore oil drilling in 2018 to protect the reef.

keyTerms.meaning: Travel to see and protect nature.
